# Dashboard illustrations / 数据看板插图

The maintained architecture and publication diagrams are Mermaid diagrams in the [English design](../../../docs/design/dashboard.md) and [Chinese design](../../../i18n/zh-CN/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/design/dashboard.md).

当前架构与发布流程图以 Mermaid 形式维护在[英文设计](../../../docs/design/dashboard.md)和[中文设计](../../../i18n/zh-CN/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/design/dashboard.md)中。

This directory contains one original screenshot for each business example:

本目录保留两个业务示例的原始截图：

- `walmart-core-desktop-20260929.png`: synthetic retail example / 合成零售示例。
- `apple-core-desktop-20260929.png`: historical Apple financial example / Apple 历史财务示例。

The English and Chinese walkthroughs share these original screenshots through `/img/dashboard/`; the captured UI remains Chinese. These historical illustrations do not establish that a newer commit passed a browser test. Fresh test screenshots and traces belong in test output. Template-gallery preview assets are maintained under [`web/public/dashboard-templates`](../../../../web/public/dashboard-templates/).

中英文案例通过 `/img/dashboard/` 共用原始截图，截图中的界面保留中文。历史插图不代表新提交已通过浏览器测试。新测试的截图和 trace 放在测试输出目录；模板库封面位于 [`web/public/dashboard-templates`](../../../../web/public/dashboard-templates/)。
